run_bm_raysampling: run the bm_raysampling benchmark to measure raysampler performance across camera types and configurations
benchmark_raysampler: benchmark PyTorch3D raysamplers using fvcore across Multinomial, NDCMultinomial, and MonteCarlo types
test_raysampler_combinations: test raysampler performance across all combinations of camera types, batch sizes, and image dimensions
review_bm_raysampling: review the bm_raysampling function and its case grid for raysampler benchmark parameters
refactor_bm_raysampling: refactor the bm_raysampling case grid to add new raysampler or camera types to benchmark
